parts.question: A set of questions and an answer sheet are in the envelope.
Write your 4-digit student code in every student code box.
The questions in Part A have only one correct answer. Mark the correct answer with “X” on the Answer Sheet clearly, as shown below. No. A B C D E F A0 X
Use pencils and erasers. You can use a scale and a calculator provided.
Some of the questions may be marked “DELETED”. DO NOT answer these questions.

Stop answering and put down your pencil IMMEDIATELY after the end bell rings. Student Code: ___________ 20th INTERNATIONAL BIOLOGY OLYMPIAD Tsukuba, JAPAN 12th – 19th July, 2009 THEORETICAL TEST: PART A Time available: 120 minutes
